title: Foreign Investment Route & Parent Board Resolution
description: Confirm 100% FDI automatic route eligibility. Foreign parent passes board resolution authorizing Indian private limited subsidiary incorporation and appointing authorized signatories.

title: Director Identification & Digital Signatures (DIN & DSC)
description: Appoint at least two directors, with at least one Indian resident director (182+ days residency). Obtain Digital Signature Certificates (DSC) and Director Identification Numbers (DIR-3).

title: MCA SPICe+ Integrated Company Incorporation
description: File SPICe+ (INC-32) along with electronic Memorandum (INC-33) and Articles of Association (INC-34), obtaining Certificate of Incorporation, corporate PAN, and TAN.

title: Corporate Bank Account & Equity Inward Remittance
description: Open corporate current account with an Authorised Dealer (AD) Category-I bank. Remit paid-up equity share capital from abroad and secure Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC).

title: RBI FIRMS Entity Master & FC-GPR Filing
description: Register entity master on RBI FIRMS portal, allot shares within statutory window, obtain valuation certificate from chartered accountant, and submit Form FC-GPR.

title: GST Registration & Letter of Undertaking (LUT)
description: Register for GST (REG-01). Submit annual Letter of Undertaking (RFD-11) for zero-rated export of IT/ITeS services without payment of integrated GST.

title: Intercompany Agreement & Transfer Pricing Policy
description: Execute master intercompany services agreement between parent and Indian subsidiary establishing arm's length cost-plus transfer pricing mechanism and benchmark study.

title: STPI Registration or SEZ Customs Bonding
description: Submit application to Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) or SEZ Development Commissioner for bonded software export status and duty exemptions on capital goods.

title: Managed Workspace Lease & Stamp Duty Registration
description: Finalize managed enterprise workspace agreement or commercial lease. Execute state stamp duty adjudication and municipal registration.

title: Employer Statutory Registrations (EPFO, ESIC, Shops & Est.)
description: Complete Employees' Provident Fund (EPFO), Employees' State Insurance (ESIC), state Shops and Commercial Establishments licence, and Professional Tax enrolment.

title: POSH Internal Committee & Workplace Conduct Policies
description: Draft employment handbook, establish Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) policy, and formally constitute Internal Committee with external member.

title: Data Protection Notices & Incident Reporting Framework
description: Implement privacy notices complying with Digital Personal Data Protection Act, establish data processing agreements, and formulate 6-hour CERT-In incident reporting plan.
